oids.name: acFail
oids.description: Alarm that alert about AC outages in the last 10 minutes: 0 - DC-UPS in normal operation. 1 - Occur a AC fail in the last 10 minutes.

oids.name: batteryCharging
oids.description: Show the status of charging Battery: 1 - The battery is on charging. 0 - The battery is on discharging.

oids.name: batteryDischarging
oids.description: Show the status of discharging Battery: 1 - The battery is on discharging. 0 - The battery is on charging.

oids.name: overheat
oids.description: Alarm that alert about overtemperature of DC-UPS 1 - The DC-UPS is in condition of overtemperature. 0 - The DC-UPS is in normal condition.

oids.name: overload
oids.description: Alarm that alert about overload of DC-UPS 1 - The DC-UPS is in condition of overload. 0 - The DC-UPS is in normal condition.

oids.name: fanAfail
oids.description: Alarm that alert about fail in internal FAN A 1 - Internal FAN with fail. 0 - Internal FAN ok

oids.name: fanBfail

oids.name: innerTemperature
oids.description: Show the internal temperature of power supply. Uses the unit degree Celsius. Example Read value: 25, temperature is 25ºC.

oids.name: outerTemperature
oids.description: Show the temperature of external sensor (cable that comes with power supply). Uses the unit degree Celsius. Example Read value: 25, temperature is 25ºC.

oids.name: heatSinkTemperature
oids.description: Show the temperature of sensor in the heatsink of power supply use the unit degree Celsius. Example Read value: 25, temperature is 25ºC.
